title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Image Dataset Quality Assurance in Multi-Center Breast MRI
abstract: arXiv:2608.16725v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Corrupted, inconsistent, or anomalous data silently threatens the safety and reliability of medical AI. Despite growing regulatory recognition of dataset quality assurance (QA) for high-risk medical AI, scalable automated detection remains underdeveloped. We employ unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as an automated dataset QA mechanism for multi-center dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI.   We build a controlled AD benchmark of 17 realistic QA-relevant anomaly types from six public datasets (protocol violations, processing errors, incorrect anatomical regions) and propose a taxonomy of radiological image anomalies based on human visual perception, enabling fine-grained analysis of AD failure modes. translated_title: 多中心乳腺MRI图像数据集质量保障中的无监督异常检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16725v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：损坏、不一致或异常的数据悄然威胁着医学AI的安全性和可靠性。尽管监管机构日益认识到高风险医学AI数据集质量保障（QA）的重要性，但可扩展的自动化检测仍发展不足。我们采用无监督异常检测（AD）和分布外（OOD）检测作为多中心动态对比增强乳腺MRI的自动化数据集QA机制。我们构建了一个受控的AD基准，包含来自六个公共数据集的17种现实QA相关异常类型（协议违规、处理错误、不正确的解剖区域），并提出了一种基于人类视觉感知的放射学图像异常分类法，从而能够对AD失败模式进行细粒度分析。该基准包括近OOD、中远OOD和远OOD样本，以及分布内和外部正常数据。我们评估了四种方法：一种基于投影的方法，并扩展了领域特定的变体。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于无监督异常检测和分布外检测的自动化数据集质量保障机制，并构建了包含17种现实异常类型和细粒度分类法的多中心乳腺MRI基准，以提升医学AI数据可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated dataset quality assurance mechanism using unsupervised anomaly detection and out-of-distribution detection, along with a benchmark of 17 realistic anomaly types and a fine-grained taxonomy for multi-center breast MRI to enhance medical AI data reliability.
